title: Tong-Il

symbol.name: Tong-Il
symbol.meaning: The reunification of Korea · ITF pattern 24 of 24

note.p: Tong-Il stands for the resolution to reunify Korea, divided since 1945. The diagram, a single line, stands for one homogeneous people. You start in parallel stance with an overlapped back hand at the centre of the C–D line facing D: slow twin punches and a twin knife-hand strike; inward blocks and punches; back hand strikes with inward vertical kicks into the palm; a slow twin palm block and reverse knife-hand blocks; downward and outward vertical kicks with back fist strikes; bow wrist and palm pressing blocks; knife-hand rising blocks, upset punches and angle fingertip thrusts each way; reverse knife-hand guarding blocks; back forearm strikes on one leg with back kicks; four W-shape blocks in sitting stance; a jump into X-stance, under fist strikes, palm pushing and knife-hand circular blocks; and a side kick, twin elbow thrust, side punch and last punch to finish.

footer: Move numbers follow the ITF Encyclopedia count (56 movements; the side kick and the twin elbow thrust of 54 are split into -1 and -2 here). The whole pattern is on the C–D line, so the board shows the moves in order, read down the page in rows; the minimap shows roughly where each one is. Directions use the ITF letters: you start facing D, with B on your left and A on your right; AC, BC, AD and BD are diagonals. Finish by bringing the right foot back to the ready posture.

moves.desc: Stand at the centre of the C–D line facing D in parallel stance with an overlapped back hand.
Move the right foot back to C into a left walking stance facing D. Twin fist middle punch, slowly.
Move the left foot back to C into a right walking stance facing D. Twin knife-hand horizontal strike, slowly.
Move the left foot to D into a right rear foot stance facing D (left foot forward on its ball). Left outer forearm middle inward block.
Slip into a left walking stance facing D. Right palm low inward block, the left side fist in front of the right shoulder.
Move the right foot to D into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right middle side punch.
In the same stance, left middle punch, fast after 5.
Stamp the left foot forward toward D into a right L-stance (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left back hand high outward strike.
Right inward vertical kick into the left palm, with the reverse footsword.
Stamp the right foot forward toward D into a left L-stance (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right back hand high outward strike.
Left inward vertical kick into the right palm, with the reverse footsword.
Lower the left foot toward D, then slip into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Twin palm horizontal block, slowly.
Move the right foot to D into a right walking stance. Right reverse knife-hand high side block, slowly.
In the same stance, left reverse knife-hand middle side block, slowly.
In the same stance, right middle punch.
In the same stance, left middle punch, fast after 14.
Right downward kick toward AC, the hands held where they were.
Stamp the right foot down toward C into a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Right back fist downward strike.
Left outward vertical kick toward BC, the hands held where they were.
Stamp the left foot down toward C into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Left back fist downward strike.
Pivoting on the left foot, turn into a right walking stance facing D. Left high punch.
In the same stance, right high punch, fast after 20.
Move the left foot to D into a right rear foot stance (left foot forward on its ball). Left bow wrist upward block.
Move the right foot to D into a left rear foot stance (right foot forward on its ball). Right bow wrist upward block.
Move the left foot to C into a left walking stance facing C. Left palm pressing block.
Move the right foot to C into a right walking stance facing C. Right palm pressing block.
Bring the left foot to the right foot into a closed stance facing C, both hands circling in front of the lower abdomen, the right knife-hand striking into the left palm.
Move the left foot to D into a left walking stance facing D. Left knife-hand rising block.
In the same stance, right high punch.
Slide toward D into a left L-stance facing D (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Left upset punch, the right side fist in front of the left shoulder.
Move the right foot back to C into a left walking stance facing D. Right angle fingertip high thrust.
Move the left foot along the C–D line into a right walking stance facing C. Right knife-hand rising block.
In the same stance, left high punch.
Slide toward C into a right L-stance facing C (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Right upset punch, the left side fist in front of the right shoulder.
Move the left foot back to D into a right walking stance facing C. Left angle fingertip high thrust.
Pivoting on the left foot, turn into a left L-stance facing C (right foot forward, weight on the left leg). Reverse knife-hand low guarding block, in a circular motion.
Pivoting on the right foot, turn into a right L-stance facing D (left foot forward, weight on the right leg). Reverse knife-hand low guarding block, in a circular motion.
Slip the left foot forward into a left walking stance facing D. Right forearm low block and left knife-hand middle outward block, together.
Stamp the right foot forward toward D into a right walking stance. Twin fist high vertical punch.
Pull the right reverse footsword up to the left knee joint into a left one-leg stance facing D. Right back forearm strike into the left palm.
Right middle back piercing kick toward C, pulling both hands apart.
Lower the right foot toward C into a sitting stance facing A. W-shape block.
Slide toward C, keeping the sitting stance. W-shape block.
Stamp the right foot toward D, turning counter-clockwise into a sitting stance facing B. W-shape block.
Slide toward C, keeping the sitting stance. W-shape block.
Pull the left reverse footsword up to the right knee joint into a right one-leg stance facing C. Left back forearm strike into the right palm.
Left high back piercing kick toward D, pulling both hands apart.
Land the left foot toward C with a jump, into a left X-stance facing C. X-fist pressing block.
Move the right foot to D into a left walking stance facing C. Left under fist front strike.
Move the right foot to C into a right walking stance facing C. Right under fist front strike.
In the same stance, left palm middle pushing block toward C.
Turn into a left walking stance facing AD. Right knife-hand circular block toward A.
Move the left foot to C into a left walking stance facing C. Right palm middle pushing block.
Turn into a right walking stance facing BD. Left knife-hand circular block toward B.
Right high side piercing kick toward D, forming a forearm guarding block.
Lower the right foot to the left foot into a closed stance facing D. Twin side back elbow thrust.
Move the left foot to D into a sitting stance facing A. Left middle side punch toward D.
Pivoting on the left foot, turn into a left walking stance facing D. Right middle punch.
